title: A failure needs its history
narration: This robot collided. Choosing a checkpoint to retrain needs its lineage, sensor contract and exact test results. Falkor-D-B connects that evidence.

title: A complete MCP run: four gates passed
narration: My agent used M-C-P and Falkor-D-B to launch real robot training. The run passed four validation gates.

title: The agent launches training
narration: It chooses a starting checkpoint and calls start training. The guardrail approves the evidence and budget before the worker starts.

title: FalkorDB connects the evidence
narration: Falkor-D-B connects each policy to its training run, evaluations, failures and recorded decisions.

title: A shortest path through real lineage
narration: Its shortest-path query returned a passing ancestor, one hop away. The agent compared seventeen eligible origins and chose a different checkpoint.

title: The guardrail can veto the agent
narration: The guardrail checks sensor contracts, artifact hashes, complete validation and the training budget. It can veto an incompatible origin.

title: The Decision precedes the action
narration: Before training, a Decision saves the model, tool calls, Cypher, parameters and returned records. Planning stops without Falkor-D-B.

title: Real PPO, then saved-policy evaluation
narration: The worker trained sixty-one thousand, four hundred forty P-P-O steps, then reloaded the checkpoint for one hundred eighty validation episodes.

title: Four suites. The same fixed gate.
narration: All four suites passed the unchanged gate. Target collisions were three in sixty. Open had zero; static and crossing had one each in forty.

title: Target and crossing regressed
narration: But the parent had two target collisions and no crossing collisions. Both measures got worse. Passing the gate does not establish an improvement, so I kept the demo policy unchanged.

title: The next agent read the regression
narration: The next agent read that regression and the weighted graph ranking. Its context limit stopped the attempt before training. I did not retry.

title: The shipped checkpoint passed fresh confirmation
narration: The shipped graph-selected checkpoint passed all four validation suites and fresh confirmation. Eight target collisions in a hundred episodes, below the ten percent limit.

title: Every action is a node you can query
narration: Every action is a node you can query. Inspect the Decision, the live demo and the evidence. EmbodiWeave. Built on Falkor-D-B.
